params.name: Activity
params.desc: Controls the density of the effects. Increase value to add complexity and variety.

params.name: Shape
params.desc: Applies a contour to the volume or filter characteristics of the effect.

params.name: Cutoff
params.desc: Cuts high frequencies with the Low-pass filter.

params.name: Mix
params.desc: Sets the balance between input signal and effect.

params.name: Time
params.desc: Controls either the Time Subdivision or Global Tempo.

params.name: Repeats
params.desc: Determines the effect duration or frequency. Works in tandem with Activity knob. Repeats function varies preset to preset.

params.name: Space
params.desc: Mixes in reverberation and delay. When at 127, mix is 100% wet.

params.name: Loop level
params.desc: Sets the playback volume of Phrase Looper.

params.name: Time
params.usage: 0~31: Bright room; 32~63: Dark medium; 64~95: Large hall; 96~127: Ambient
params.desc: Selects 1 of 4 reverb modes. These reverb options vary in length and character.

params.name: Only
params.desc: Allows you to mute the effects and use the pedal as a traditional looper.

params.name: Burst
params.desc: Burst allows for the creation of fast, one-layer loops.

params.name: Quantized
params.desc: When the Phrase Looper is set to Quantize, Microcosm will trim your loop to the nearest beat in order to synchronize the loop to the effect tempo.

params.name: Hold Sampler
params.desc: On to freeze a recent piece of your playing into a continuous playback cycle.

params.name: Tap tempo
params.desc: Microcosm smoothly matches the tempo to the timing of quarter note taps.
